Method of Attack: Utilizes virtual machines to deploy encryptors on network devices stealthily
Runs on remote systems or encrypts remote SMB or CIFS network shares
Installs VirtualBox and creates a virtual machine using a customized Alpine OS Linux ISO
Uses scripts and utilities to dump passwords, spread laterally, build BlackCat 'Sphynx' encryptor payload, and execute programs on network computers
Changes root password on boot, uses 'tmux' to execute Rust-based malware binary 'controller' that loads attack scripts
Generates custom BlackCat encryptor executables pushed to remote devices for file and network share encryption
Provides isolation from OS to bypass security solutions and reduce detection
Automated operations reduce manual intervention and noise
Modular with Python scripts and configurable payload swapping
Impacted Systems: Devices compromised by BlackCat ransomware affiliates
Attack Vector: Compromise of device followed by installation of VirtualBox and Munchkin ISO
Use of virtual machines to isolate and execute ransomware payloads
